Parallel to my academic work I have spent five years in people analytics and HR data
analysis in global engineering organisations. The two tracks feed each other: modelling
teaches me to be careful about what the numbers can support, and analytics practice keeps me
close to imperfect data, stakeholders on a deadline, and results that have to be explained to
people who do not read econometrics.
